# NodeSim

> A modern, browser-based circuit simulator powered by ngspice.

NodeSim is a free alternative to NI Multisim. Design, build, and run professional SPICE circuit simulations entirely in your browser without an account.

## Features
- Real-time SPICE simulation powered by ngspice WASM
- DC Sweep, AC Sweep, and Transient Analysis
- Oscilloscope and grapher with interactive cursors
- Example circuits for students (555 timers, op-amps, logic gates)
